question: What is the name of the project launched by HDFC Bank in collaboration with the Indian Air Force and CSC Academy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Project HAKK.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **HDFC Bank launched Project HAKK (Hawai Anubhavi Kalyan Kendra) to provide support and services to defence pensioners, veterans, and their families.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Project HAKK aims to empower defence veterans and their families through skill development and training on financial products and services.**
 
• The project will initially set up 25 centres across key Air Force units to provide services to veterans.
 
• More than 500 services will be available, including Aadhaar, NPS, PAN Card, passport services, and pension-related assistance.
 
• CSC Academy will train the individuals managing the centres, and HDFC Bank will provide them with financial support during the first year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• HDFC Bank__

 __
 
• HDFC Bank is one of India’s leading private sector banks with a focus on providing innovative banking solutions across the country.
 
• Its services are available through an extensive network of banking outlets and ATMs.
 
 
 
• CSC Academy__
 __
 
• CSC Academy is a government initiative aimed at offering skill development and training programs for the empowerment of individuals in rural and urban areas.
 
• The academy works closely with several public and private sector organizations to provide educational and employment opportunities.
 
 
 
• Indian Air Force__
 
 
• The Indian Air Force (IAF) is one of the three branches of the Indian Armed Forces, tasked with safeguarding Indian airspace and providing air support to the Indian Army and Navy.
 
• The IAF plays a crucial role in national defense and security operations.
